title: Jayhawks win 2nd place at Rocky Mountain Debating Championship Tournament
summary_en: The University of Kansas debate team of Michael Redlich, Kansas City, Missouri, and Jack Turec, Olathe, took second place at a British Parliamentary debate tournament Oct. 24-25 co-hosted by the University of Denver and Metropolitan State University-Denver.
title_cn: Jayhawks win 2nd place at Rocky Mountain Debating Championship Tournament

title: KU social work degree programs earn Council on Social Work Education reaccreditation
summary_en: The Bachelor of Social Work (BSW) and Master of Social Work (MSW) programs are fully accredited by the Council on Social Work Education (CSWE) for another eight years, through the 2033-2034 academic year.
title_cn: KU social work degree programs earn Council on Social Work Education reaccreditation

title: Symposium to explore tribal sovereignty, climate change and children’s health
summary_en: American Indian law scholars and advocates will gather Nov. 12-13 in Lawrence to discuss “Sovereignty: Good Medicine for Healthy Nations & Healthy People.” Hosted by the University of Kansas School of Law and Haskell Indian Nations University, the symposium will explore the critical relationship of public policy and law with the environmental degradation that accompanies global climate change.
title_cn: Symposium to explore tribal sovereignty, climate change and children’s health
